sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 13 March 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000020-P1 was put before Blue Ridge Medical Group 020 on behalf of PFIZER.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 2 rebate of 4 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Pneumococcal minimum take of 240 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
